src: <formal> <deva> कानुन, न्याय तथा संसदीय मामिला विभागका सचिव, प्रधानमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रिपरिषद् कार्यालयमा सचिव (कानुन), नेपालका महान्यायाधिवक्ताद्वारा मनोनीत महान्यायाधिवक्ता तथा एनएलसीका सचिव, जसले सदस्य-सचिवको रूपमा पनि काम गर्छन्, पदेन सदस्य हुन्।
tgt: The Secretary at the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Secretary (Law) at the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers, Deputy Attorney General nominated by the Attorney General of Nepal and the Secretary at the NLC, who also serves as a Member-Secretary, are ex-officio members.
english: The Secretary at the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Secretary (Law) at the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers, Deputy Attorney General nominated by the Attorney General of Nepal and the Secretary at the NLC, who also serves as a Member-Secretary, are ex-officio members.
